public.title: Maximum Product Subarray
public.description: Return the largest product of a nonempty contiguous subarray. values contains 1 to 20 integers from -5 to 5; every contiguous product is guaranteed to be a safe integer.
hints: Keep both the largest and smallest product ending at each position.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A negative value swaps the roles of extremes. Extend either prior extreme or restart at the current value, in O(n) time.
